def transform(grid):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    # The center column is a uniform separator between two equal-width patterns.
    sep = next(c for c in range(cols) if all(grid[r][c] != 0 for r in range(rows)) and len({grid[r][c] for r in range(rows)}) == 1)
    width = min(sep, cols - sep - 1)
    left = [row[sep-width:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep+1:sep+1+width] for row in grid]
    return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(lrow, rrow)] for lrow, rrow in zip(left, right)]
